description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens plus at least one additional token due to Tippy-Toe.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
